  • Suitable for combination and oily skin types
  • Waterproof formula with 24-hour wear
  • Buildable medium to full coverage
  • Satin matte finish

Achieve a flawless complexion with the Clinique Even Better Clinical™ Serum Foundation SPF20. Designed to improve the appearance of bare skin, the lightweight formula uses serum technologies to leave skin feeling smooth and youthful-looking.

Boasting waterproof, 24-hour wear, the oil-free foundation offers buildable medium to full coverage with a satin matte finish. It works to improve the look of your complexion as you wear it, with 90% saying bare skin appears smoother, more even-toned and radiant*.

A combination of the brand’s unique UP302 molecule with vitamin C, helps to brighten the complexion and reduce the look of dark spots. Salicylic acid targets clogged pores and blemishes, while hyaluronic acid offers a plumping effect with a boost of hydration. An SPF20 provides protection from harmful UV rays and helps to minimise the risk of discolouration.

Ideal for combination and oily skin types.

Dermatologist tested.

*consumer testing on 221 women after using product for 8 weeks
  • For best results, apply after moisturiser.
  • Start with just a half-pump; this formula is so concentrated, a little goes a long way.
  • We recommend using the Foundation Buff brush for the most flawless finish, but use your preferred technique. Apply a small amount of foundation where you need coverage the most and blend from there. You can then add more foundation for additional coverage.
  • For extra coverage, pair with Clinique Concealer.
  • Remove with your favourite Clinique makeup remover; Take the Day Off Cleansing Balm.
